say:2:1041567401:1.text: I see that you've been investing in Brimstone Village. You must be optimistic about the development over there.
say:2:1041567401:1.source_cn: 我看到你这次对深岩村进行的投资方案了，你看好那边的发展？

say:3:1041567402:1.text: Yes, I went to survey the area myself. Despite encountering a few mishaps, the overall outlook remains promising.
say:3:1041567402:1.source_cn: 当然，我实地去考察过，尽管遭遇了一些事故，但总体而言前...

say:4:1041567403:1.text: By the way, I'm not trying to monopolize this opportunity. Is the Mithril Consortium planning on investing as well?
say:4:1041567403:1.source_cn: 我没想过占据全部的份额，所以秘银商会打算加入吗？

say:5:1041567404:1.text: I intend to, but not in the name of the Mithril Consortium.
say:5:1041567404:1.source_cn: 我确实有这个打算，不过不是以秘银商会的名义。

say:6:1041567405:1.text: A private venture seems wiser at this stage. I'd prefer not to overextend my influence over the Mithril Consortium prematurely.
say:6:1041567405:1.source_cn: 应该是我以私人名义先行进入，毕竟我还无法完全影响秘银商...

say:7:1041567406:1.text: Like that private venture in Ryeham?
say:7:1041567406:1.source_cn: 就像你对金穗村提供的投资方案一样？

say:8:1041567407:1.text: Even now, I can't help but marvel at the sheer boldness you showed back then.
say:8:1041567407:1.source_cn: 我现在还非常惊叹于你当时的胆量。

say:9:1041567408:1.text: The two biggest troublesome issues I had in Ryeham at the time were actually the yield of wheat, followed by the business environment.
say:9:1041567408:1.source_cn: 金穗村当时困扰我的最大根源其实是小麦的产量，其次才是营...

say:10:1041567409:1.text: But after securing the yield, the subsequent business environment was actually quite manageable.
say:10:1041567409:1.source_cn: 在确保产量后，后续的环境其实很好处理。

say:11:1041567410:1.text: And it was all because I was there locally and knew all the issues at hand.
say:11:1041567410:1.source_cn: 本质上还是因为，当时我正在实地走访，所以一切发展都心中有数。

say:12:1041567411:1.text: That's why I dared to invest in the project.
say:12:1041567411:1.source_cn: 所以才敢整理出方案进行投资。

say:13:1041567412:1.text: Yes, boldness means nothing without understanding. In business as in war, you must first learn to see clearly before you dare to act decisively.
say:13:1041567412:1.source_cn: 果然，无论怎样的大胆，前提都得是自身建立起足够的认知，...

say:14:1041567413:1.text: It is the same with you. No one would believe that the wealthy businessman Baelran would have the patience to visit and inspect projects himself.
say:14:1041567413:1.source_cn: 你也一样，很难有人相信奢华的富商巴赫朗会有耐性一个个去...

say:15:1041567414:1.text: Perhaps I was just too bored at home and needed a change of scenery?
say:15:1041567414:1.source_cn: 或许我也只是在家待得无聊了，想换换环境呢？
